name: CPS Counter
description: Shows your clicks per second in real time, the peak CPS, and the total click count for the current attempt or level.

show-realtime.name: Show real-time CPS
show-realtime.description: Clicks per second, measured over the tracking window below.

show-total.name: Show total clicks
show-total.description: Total clicks this attempt or level.

total-mode.name: Total clicks resets on
total-mode.description: "Per attempt" resets every death, "Per level" keeps counting until you leave the level.

window-ms.name: CPS window (ms)
window-ms.description: How long a click keeps counting toward real-time CPS. Lower = twitchier.

offset-x.name: Offset X
offset-x.description: Distance from the left edge of the screen.

offset-y.name: Offset Y
offset-y.description: Distance from the top edge of the screen.
